purpose: Run GitHub JavaScript through MetaProcedure JS Runner, POST a JavaScript function to Apps Script, inspect the supplied Drive Takeout ZIP, and write a separate Drive inspection report.
constraints: Do not overwrite the source ZIP.
Do not attempt in-memory unzip for archives over 25 MB.
Write inspection results to Google Drive.
Require returned Drive file identifiers before reporting execution success.

execution.operation: Run JSON script with existing JS Runner
POST sourcecode and arguments to deployed Apps Script
Read ZIP metadata and conditionally enumerate small archive entries
Create Drive inspection JSON and return its file ID
Persist result to GitHub for inspection
